scenes.summary: A majestic gallopbeast loiters around the path you must take. She happens to be Ye Minghe's mount. Si then reveals the man's true identity to you — An Imperial Guard of Yan.

lines.text: {F}A gallopbeast...{M}A gallopbeast...
This particular species is indigenous to Talos-II. They're fast and wild.
That brighthaired boy might be the only Talosian who can ride them into battle. The others couldn't even saddle these beasts.
Quit guessing — Ye Minghe is an Imperial Guard of Yan</>.
But HAS needed people who could handle the toughest fights and challenges. Unfortunately, they were also cut off from Terra.
So Tianshi Tan, Hongshan's most senior member and a decisive leader, made the call and created another unit of Imperial Guards.
Silly dark-haired nag</>. I hope you didn't stomp around and break my beautiful cliffs.
{F}So this is Mister Minghe's mount... Who is he, exactly?{M}So this is Mister Minghe's mount... Who is he, exactly?
The original Imperial Guards answered only to the True Lung of Yan</>. None of them ever came to Talos-II...
Tan appreciated Ye Minghe's talents. She personally recruited him, and even gave him the title of "Captain of Pacified Skies</>".
{F}So Hongshan actually sent one of their best...{M}So Hongshan actually sent one of their best...
Hmph. I gave my leave to let him observe, but he's now messing up my process.
Alright, we ascend.

scenes.summary: You expose the Ink Spirits for being Si's mouthpieces. She is worried that your body is unable to receive the final treatment and hopes you can be better rested before rushing to Dijiang. However, you manage to persuade her otherwise.

lines.text: {F}The brush isn't working?{M}The brush isn't working?
Hmm. Maybe it's out of ink. We might as well take a break.
{F}But I can already see the cabins of "Dijiang" from here...{M}But I can already see the cabins of "Dijiang" from here...
We've been rushing non-stop, and I'm so tired... Mmm, speaking of which, didn't you hear what the little ones said?
You knew it all along?
Did you forget how terrible you looked at the chess pavilion? You thought you could brush it off by saying some nice words?
Your body had a severe reaction. Yet all I did was run some diagnostics. If we reach the peak...
...the treatment will only be much more intense. I don't know if you'd survive that.
I know I brought you here, but if we go any further, there'll be no turning back.
We can do this another day, or even find another solution...
Quit saying Endfield or Talos-II needs you. I'm tired of it.

{F}Actually, when I saw you delaying my treatment at the inn, I knew at once this was going to be risky.{M}Actually, when I saw you delaying my treatment at the inn, I knew at once this was going to be risky.
{F}But overthinking only doubles your worry, and delaying the solution won't solve the problem.{M}But overthinking only doubles your worry, and delaying the solution won't solve the problem.

{F}And ... come on, you've come this far with me. If I gave up now, I'd be letting you down ... right?{M}And ... come on, you've come this far with me. If I gave up now, I'd be letting you down ... right?
Y-you got me... If you're that sure about this, then let's keep going.
{F}Of course. They just appeared to give me a reminder, didn't they?{M}Of course. They just appeared to give me a reminder, didn't they?
And you'd keep playing dumb, if I hadn't stopped on purpose?
Don't you know that every time you pass out, there's a chance that you'd never wake again?

options: I know you're worried about me, but...
I know, it's my body. But...

scenes.summary: Ye Minghe waits by "Dijiang" for you and Si. You learn that you must repair the last site of damage on your own in order to permanently treat your injury. It is extremely risky, but you alone must face the unknown.

lines.text: Hey dolt ... just ... take very good care of yourself.
Nuli.
I've already had enough of your nagging; now you're letting your galloper roam around?
Apologies. An Imperial Guard must uphold his duty. I have to ensure the Endministrator's treatment goes smoothly.
This one mirrors the Æther injury within you. It's the hardest to fix.
To treat this for good, you must endure the agony and overcome all obstacles... No one else can help you in this.
And there's a chance we might lose you forever...
Since Lady Si has her concerns, allow me to act in her stead for this process.
No wonder I couldn't chase you off. This is your plan right from the beginning, isn't it?
{F}You said things wouldn't be entirely pleasant. Now I see what you meant.{M}You said things wouldn't be entirely pleasant. Now I see what you meant.
Endministrator, please have faith in HAS ... and in me. Your safety is of the utmost concern to us.
{F}...Very well, I'm counting on you, Mister Minghe...{M}...Very well, I'm counting on you, Mister Minghe...
Thankfully, you have arrived promptly. We still have time to repair the last site of damage.

{F}This looks way worse than the previous ones we fixed. Being next to Dijiang makes it look more severe...{M}This looks way worse than the previous ones we fixed. Being next to Dijiang makes it look more severe...
You? That doesn't make me feel any better.
I know this concerns the Endministrator's safety, and you don't want anyone else involved.
But, milady, that's exactly why we need you free, so you can look out for us.
This is the safest arrangement. If we're doing this, every risk must be kept to a minimum.
The last site of damage is beyond ordinary. Even opening it will take great effort.

scenes.summary: You see "Nefarith" in the mysterious realm. She tells you this is a deep recess of your mind. You must dispel the shadows with brush and blade, and force yourself to directly confront your inner voice.

lines.text: Need a hand, my dear, dear "Savior"?
{F}Nefarith...?{M}Nefarith...?
Why waste your energy? This is just a deep recess of your mind, and I am just one of the many shadows within.
Now tell me, why couldn't you just forget these voices?
{F}The Foundation, its creations, and the likes of you... are enemies of the Civilization Band.{M}The Foundation, its creations, and the likes of you... are enemies of the Civilization Band.
This is a unique realm. Use the brush well, so your blade can dispel the other shadows.
How laughable. A Savior cursed to keep swinging a blade.
Oh really? Then why do they still forgive you, and hope you'll change your mind?
Why are they so devoted to you? Where do their anger and doubt come from? What did you do? Who are you exactly?
Perhaps you do not care. Or ... you dare not think further.

scenes.summary: You meet "Ardashir", who prophesies that you will keep using your powers to save others, only to worsen your injuries, and how you will wither away in misunderstanding and hatred.

lines.text: Please stop. You are already exhausted.
{F}Now it's you, Ardashir...{M}Now it's you, Ardashir...
It doesn't matter who's trying to remind you. It's your body. You know it best, don't you?
Alleikhreos has reopened the wound inflicted on you by Æther. Your physical form will collapse like an avalanche.
One by one our exiled kin will return, yet you turned your back, and foolishly chose the path of hate.
Your choices will nourish the wound. You will gradually push yourself ... till utmost destruction.
The future is obvious. To protect the Civilization Band, you will continue to use your powers, over and over again.
{F}Even then, the likes of you will not succeed.{M}Even then, the likes of you will not succeed.
{F}I do not fight alone. Countless others will rise and stop you.{M}I do not fight alone. Countless others will rise and stop you.
It seems you have great faith in your followers.
But how many of them are there? And how would you convince them that your great enterprise will succeed?

scenes.summary: You fail to save the "Endfield Operator" you met. With her final words, she remains faithful to your "Zeroth Directive" and how you will eventually see it done to achieve the Reboot of Life.

lines.text: Endmin, you're finally here...
You don't have to remember every one of us ... who followed you ... or fought by your side...
Your body is on the verge of collapse, isn't it? You've been forcing yourself to carry on...
Please remember: no matter what happens, you have truly earned our trust.
Even if your memories fade, the "Zeroth Directive" you left us ... shall continue to lead us forward.
Or ... are you grieving for me?
I've reached my end, but your path lies ahead... Go. Complete the "Zeroth Directive" and achieve the Reboot of Life.
Is this snow...? Ah... I thought I'd never feel it again. The snow from home...
As long as the Civilization Band endures, and Endfield continues to protect the people, our sacrifices ... will be meaningful.

scenes.summary: You finally come face to face with "yourself". And with that meeting comes the challenge you can no longer avoid: Do you truly understand the "Zeroth Directive"? Do you know whether it is truly just or fair? And do you know who you are?

lines.text: {F}"Zeroth Directive". An arrangement of your design ... that binds the fate of countless individuals together.{M}"Zeroth Directive". An arrangement of your design ... that binds the fate of countless individuals together.
{F}Your injuries lie not in the Æther, but in yourself. Can you even ... fix this?{M}Your injuries lie not in the Æther, but in yourself. Can you even ... fix this?

{F}You don't know how the "Zeroth Directive" was conceived, nor where it leads. You don't even know if it brings hope, or more disasters...{M}You don't know how the "Zeroth Directive" was conceived, nor where it leads. You don't even know if it brings hope, or more disasters...
{F}You don't even know if it is just or fair.{M}You don't even know if it is just or fair.

{F}Ten years have passed and you re-entered the game, only to become the one most oblivious to the truth.{M}Ten years have passed and you re-entered the game, only to become the one most oblivious to the truth.
{F}"Reboot of Life". It truly serves as a great rallying call!{M}"Reboot of Life". It truly serves as a great rallying call!
{F}But how do you trigger the "Reboot"? What will "Life" be like afterwards?{M}But how do you trigger the "Reboot"? What will "Life" be like afterwards?

scenes.summary: Si and Ye Minghe confess that everything you experienced in the painting is also part of the "Zeroth Directive". In fact, you were the one who designed the hike up the mountain. It prepares you for treatment and also serves as a trial.

lines.text: Alright, people. Save the celebrations for later. This isn't over yet.
Your injuries have been healed. Go ahead and retrieve "Dijiang"... You know what to do.
What took you so long! Do you know how ... how annoyed I was waiting for you?
Just a while ago, the skies over the mountain darkened with a brewing storm. What did you experience?
{F}I just sorted a few things out. It took me a while.{M}I just sorted a few things out. It took me a while.
So even you had moments of doubt on this journey...
But you have given the answer. You've passed the trial that you left for yourself.
Endmin, everything you went through in the painted world is part of the "Zeroth Directive".
Aren't you always curious about that "Dijiang"?
Ten years ago, you asked me to make a painting of the ship so that you could "store" a portion of Originium authority within it.
Should the need arise, you could retrieve the authority and temporarily eliminate Æther effects from your body.
But before that happens, you must slowly open yourself up, undergo some reflective questioning, and re-sync with this authority.
{F}So I had to hike up the mountain, and repair each of the damaged sites...?{M}So I had to hike up the mountain, and repair each of the damaged sites...?
I kept it a secret 'cause I didn't want to stress you out.
You were heavily injured and lost your memories. That challenge you left behind was no easy task. To be honest, I was really worried...
But you did it. In the end, you were the only one that could truly heal yourself.
Lady Si and I have seen every step you took in this journey. It is a great honor ... to once again learn from you in this way.
{F}Yeah. After all, this journey of mine has only just begun.{M}Yeah. After all, this journey of mine has only just begun.

options: Did you just say that I left a trial for myself?
Si, can you tell me what's going on?

scenes.summary: The mountaintop "Dijiang" happens to be a portion of your Originium authority. With it, you successfully suppress your injury. The mission within the painted world is complete. It is time to return to Dijiang.

lines.text: Hmm. Finally there's some color in your face. You're not looking so pale anymore.
The touch of Æther is slowly fading away, and the Originium will re-stabilize. We just need to wait for your body to slowly recover.
{F}I thought I retrieved the Originium authority. Why is "Dijiang" still here?{M}I thought I retrieved the Originium authority. Why is "Dijiang" still here?
"Retrieval" is just a way to put it. I can't have a bare mountaintop without proper decor. It would look ugly!
If I kept you any longer, Little Miss Supervisor will think that I've abducted you.
Ahem. Ye Minghe, where did your precious gallopbeast go?
Endmin, Lady Si, I shall take my leave.
What I mean is the HAS will continue to monitor your status, so I'll have to come knocking on your door from time to time.
Hey...! He's already gone.
Since you're done with treatment, it's time to return to Dijiang... By that, I mean the actual Dijiang.
Oh... Nuli doesn't stay put for long. I'm guilty of negligence.
Dijiang? There was a time when I yearned to visit the vessel.
But ... for various reasons, I never got to go.
And I also have quite a few experiences that I wish to share with you.
Unfortunately, fate has decided otherwise.
But worry not, Endministrator. We will soon meet again.
Don't look at me. Well, he was hinting at something... But whatever happened between you two, that's his story to tell.
Let's go. Back to Dijiang.

options: Aren't you coming with us to Dijiang?
I actually have a few questions for you.
